scientific_question: Across organizer-verified full BEHAVIOR 2026 standard-track policies, is author-defined formal goal coupling associated with lower official per-task Q after conditioning on atomic goal count?

claim_boundary.allowed: observational cross-policy association between formal BDDL goal coupling and official BEHAVIOR 2026 task Q within the fixed 100-task public challenge set
forbidden: causal effect of coupling on planning/execution difficulty
generalization beyond BEHAVIOR without new validation
using human demonstration duration as a difficulty covariate

public_release_baseline.watch_rule: any target OID/size change requests source/admission recheck; any data/README schema OID/size change requires zero-outcome preregistration recompile before outcome admission

future_release_snapshot_rule.snapshot_once: when public target files become non-empty, freeze exact Space revision and OID/size/SHA of submissions.jsonl, results.jsonl, per_task_results.jsonl before scientific statistics
future_release_snapshot_rule.schema_drift_before_release: RECOMPILE_ZERO_OUTCOME_PREREGISTRATION; do not carry this contract across schema drift

submission_admission.submission_metadata: submissions.jsonl row with stable submission_id and status=verified
submission_admission.aggregate_result: results.jsonl row with same submission_id, verified=true, num_tasks=100, num_episodes=1000
submission_admission.per_task_result: exactly one per_task_results.jsonl row for each of the 100 frozen task IDs; each row num_episodes=10; q_score finite in [0,1]
submission_admission.policy_unit_deduplication: one full verified submission per exact (team,method); if multiple qualify, select earliest submitted_at, then lexicographically smallest submission_id; never use score/rank to choose
submission_admission.if_fewer_than_minimum: HOLD; do not self-run policies to fill public evidence gap under this object

primary_analysis.task_outcome: Q_bar_task = equal-weight mean of official q_score across all admitted full policy units for that task
primary_analysis.model: OLS: Q_bar_task = beta0 + beta_edge*shared_argument_edge_count + beta_size*atomic_goal_count + error
primary_analysis.inference: HC3 heteroskedasticity-robust standard error; two-sided alpha=0.05; coefficient and 95% CI
primary_analysis.directional_expectation: beta_edge < 0, while primary significance remains two-sided

cross_policy_corroboration.per_policy_model: same OLS on each admitted policy unit’s 100 task q_score values
required_for_cross_policy_wording: at least two-thirds of admitted policy units have beta_edge < 0
at least 3 unique teams among admitted policy units
cross_policy_corroboration.if_not_met: do not claim cross-policy generality even if aggregate task-level primary model is significant

falsifiers_and_sensitivities.primary_null: beta_edge 95% CI includes 0 => no support for incremental coupling association
falsifiers_and_sensitivities.size_absorption: full model adjusted R2 must exceed size-only model adjusted R2; otherwise coupling adds no explanatory value
falsifiers_and_sensitivities.freedman_lane: fixed seed 20260828; exactly 10000 residual permutations from reduced Q_bar~atomic_goal_count; reconstruct Q*=fitted+permuted residual; refit full Q*~edge+size; observed abs(beta_edge) must strictly exceed empirical 95th percentile of null absolute coefficients
falsifiers_and_sensitivities.grounding_repair_sensitivity: exclude preregistered repair-affected challenge tasks ['cook_a_frozen_pie', 'cook_brussels_sprouts', 'sorting_household_items']; sign flip or >30% attenuation in abs(beta_edge) fails robustness
falsifiers_and_sensitivities.branch_overapproximation_sensitivity: exclude preregistered branch-bearing tasks ['laying_tile_floors', 'moving_boxes_to_storage', 'putting_up_Christmas_decorations_inside', 'setting_mousetraps', 'setup_a_bar_for_a_cocktail_party', 'sorting_books_on_shelf', 'stacking_wood']; sign flip or >30% attenuation in abs(beta_edge) fails robustness
falsifiers_and_sensitivities.secondary_metrics: LCC and goal_logic_depth are confirmatory/descriptive only and may never replace a failed shared_argument_edge_count primary result

forbidden_until_release_and_independent_: opening future q_score/result values before content-addressed release snapshot and admission freeze
manual selection of submissions by rank/score
changing formal metric or task set
changing primary model/falsifiers after public values are observed
next_gate: independent Kimi/DeepSeek review of this exact pre-outcome contract; public release watch remains zero-authority until >=3 full policy units pass one-shot admission
